He also said the store shouldn't be marked "ready" until someone makes a test booking. The thread doesn't say whether this was fixed.

- **Halyard rollout deadline and seat count: no record I can find.** Halyard doesn't come up in any channel you're in or in the public Central team files, so I can't tell you what was agreed. Hollis is probably the best person to ask. I'd leave it out of the handover until someone confirms it.
